Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly synthesize the chronological inconsistency revealed in the initial search results. In Step 1, the WebSurfer provided data showing Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart (born 1794) was the son of John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart, who died in 1794. The Planner acknowledged this inconsistency but instead of immediately pivoting to verify the lineage or searching for the correct father (who would be the 1st Marquess of Bute, as the 2nd Marquess was Patrick's elder brother), the Planner continued to delegate the same search queries to the WebSurfer in subsequent steps. This resulted in a repetitive loop where the same ambiguous information was re-queried without resolving the core genealogical error or identifying the correct father's death date.
